_comment: Meeting dates derived from the scripts themselves. Only meeting_005 is stated outright; the rest follow from anchors quoted in 'basis'. These convert the graph's ordering (source_meeting) into metric time (stated_at), which is what lets 'how long between X and Y' and 'which deadline is first' be answered at all.

meeting_001.basis: baseline CSE weekly meeting; start of the arc

meeting_002.basis: script_02 setup: 'Follow-up meeting two weeks later'

meeting_003.basis: script_05 opens 'This is the follow-up to our January meeting', and script_03 schedules the follow-up for February twenty eighth

meeting_004.basis: script_04 discusses the Board approval from meeting_003 and targets 'before the Board meets on February twenty eighth'

meeting_005.basis: stated in scripts 3 and 5: 'Scheduled for February twenty eighth'
